# canary add market --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary add market — Read stock quotes and discover or refresh exact long calls;
no orders placed

Usage: canary add market [--json] < request.json

Flags
  --json                    emit typed market evidence

Stdin: one JSON object; unknown fields and extra objects are rejected. Output is
always JSON, with or without --json.

underlying (required): stock contract with symbol, sec_type STK, currency and
exchange SMART; con_id is optional when known.

discover (optional boolean): discover call candidates for USD stocks. selected
(optional contract): refresh one exact call returned by discovery.

refresh (optional array): up to four {horizon_days, contract} objects; unique
horizons 14, 30, 60 or 120. Do not combine refresh with discover. selected and
refresh contracts must be exact USD SMART calls for the underlying, with con_id,
expiry, strike, right C, multiplier 100 and trading_class.

Options require USD. Read option_mode and per-call planning or unavailable
evidence: planning prices are not executable quotes. Use the returned exact
contract for call-plan.

Example (synthetic identity; replace with your resolved contract):
canary add market --json <<'JSON'
{
  "underlying": {
    "symbol": "SYNA",
    "sec_type": "STK",
    "currency": "USD",
    "exchange": "SMART"
  },
  "discover": true
}
JSON
